routes._comment: The installed page carries @RoutePage(name: 'DriverDeliveryZoneRoute'), so auto_route generates the route class in the host's own app_router.gr.dart - SDK lib/ pages never get one. update_router_table() owns the whole @generated-routes block, so a route not declared here is dropped on every recompose.

driver._comment_di_hooks: The DeliveryZonesFacade/ZoneEditPolicy wiring moved out of paas_driver's tracked main.dart into the #160 di_hooks mechanism (driver migration M4, the exact mirror of the manager entry below). The interfaces need no import entry - the zones_sdk barrel arrives via the generated sdk-imports block. isRegistered-guarded so a host whose tracked main.dart still registers the adapters by hand double-boots safely during its own migration window. The adapter is now a thin shim over zones_sdk's own DriverDeliveryZonesRepository (the former host user-repository delivery-zone slice), so no host-owned repository remains.

routes._comment: CupertinoRoute matches the legacy paas_manager app_router entry for this page (driver's flavour of the same path is a MaterialRoute). Declaring this block also keeps lib/src/manager/ alive through the composer's role-stripping.

manager._comment_di_hooks: The DeliveryZonesFacade wiring moved out of paas_manager's tracked main.dart into the #160 di_hooks mechanism (manager migration M5, scratchpad/di-hooks-declarations.md). DeliveryZonesFacade itself needs no import entry - the zones_sdk barrel arrives via the generated sdk-imports block. isRegistered-guarded so a host whose tracked main.dart still registers the adapter by hand double-boots safely during its own migration window. The adapter is now a thin shim over zones_sdk's own ManagerDeliveryZonesRepository (the former host users-repository delivery-zone slice), so no host-owned repository remains.
